$comment: Copy to impact.config.json at the repo root. Everything is optional.
$comment_thresholds: Calibrate AFTER measuring on this repo. A 293-entity monolith does not share the same thresholds as a microservice.
$comment_workspace: Parent directory of sibling repos, e.g. /home/dev/repos. Enables cross-repo scanning.
$comment_memoryPath: eonix-memory store (JSON). null = disabled. Relative path anchored on repo root (e.g. '.impact/memory.json'), or an absolute/central path to share incidents across repos. ADVISORY ONLY: prior incidents annotate symbols but never change the risk level or the gate decision. Format: { "incidents": [ { "symbol": "DispenseOrder", "file": "src/Order.cs", "kind": "regression", "ref": "MIL-123", "at": "2026-03-01" } ] }
